sheets.title: Wood Walkway Detail (Press 10 / Press 7)
sheets.source_document: PWS Press 10 Appendix C; PWS Press 7 Appendix C
sheets.reading_notes: Hand-drawn/typed sketch showing pressure-treated wood walkway construction: 4"x4" treated posts ~92" OC, 2"x10" joists, 2"x6" treated decking, 2"x4" braces at each post, 3'-0" width, walkway cover detail with slope. Safety yellow top rail and material slide noted. Both press lines use same walkway detail.

sheets.title: Building 561/564 Damproofing — Typical Floor Plan and Cross Section
sheets.source_document: PWS Press 10 Appendix C; PWS Press 7 Appendix C
sheets.reading_notes: Scanned hand-drawn drawings (historic) showing typical floor plan for Buildings 561/564: control room adjacent to below-grade press bay. Cross section shows press bay buried below grade, blow-off roof elevated. French drain detail with 4" slotted PVC, gravel, filter fabric, and 6-mil polyethylene sheeting behind retaining wall. Same plan applies to both 561 (Press 7) and 564 (Press 10).

sheets.title: Buildings 567/568/569 — Floor Plan and Section
sheets.source_document: PWS Press 10 Appendix C; PWS Press 7 Appendix C
sheets.reading_notes: Scanned historic drawings (scale 1/4"=1'-0") showing warming oven buildings. Floor plan indicates heater room (7'-0" x 14'-9"), oven bays (~6'-10" x 9'-6" each), and exhaust penetrations through roof. Section shows wood-framed roof (2"x8" @ 16" O.C.) on CMU/reinforced concrete walls, 3" concrete floor on cinder fill, asbestos board ceiling (noted as existing — to be abated). Note: drawings show asbestos board as existing material, consistent with PWS abatement scope. Building dimensions: oven bay coverage ~16'-8" overall, ~149'-8" length referenced on plan (likely overall plant dimensions, not individual building).

gross_square_footage.notes: Individual building footprints readable from historic plan sketches but not stated as totals. Buildings are small industrial structures. Storage sheds noted as ~12'W x 10'L x 7'H each in PWS text.

floor_count.quote: The control room is a one-story structure
floor_count.notes: Control rooms (Buildings 561, 564) are one-story above grade. Press bays are below grade. Warming oven buildings (567, 568, 569) are single-story. Blow-off roof and elevator cage are elevated roof structures, not additional occupied floors.
